title: Baba jaan alwida
body:
baap ka ghar se taboot jis dam chala
haye beti ne ro kar padha marsiya
baba jaan alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon ke ashk aankhon se honge rawan
chain ek pal na payega ab dil mera
baba jaan alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
ab talak mai tadapti thi maa ke liye
aap ki yaad aayegi ab raat din
sar pe maa baap dono ka saaya nahi
ye qayamat rulayegi ab raat din
ab to zainab hai aur ye yateemi ka gham
zindagi har qadam ab lagegi qaza
baba jaan alwida...
baap ka ghar se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ke kehti thi zainab mere baba jaan
chain ek pal kahin ab na paungi mai
aap ka aur amma ki furqat ka gham
dono ek saath kaise uthaungi mai
ab nigahon mein chaaya rahega dhuaan
aur rulayega har dam khayaal aap ka
baba jaan alwida...
baap ka ghar se...
<<DIVIDER>>
naam jab bhi yateemi ka sunti thi mai
kaamp jaata tha seene mein mera jigar
kaise rehte hai bacche pidar ke bina
dil dehelta tha is baat ko soch kar
mujhko himmat ki dekar ke jaayein dua
ab yateemi se zainab ka hai saamna
baba jaan alwida...
baap ka ghar se...
<<DIVIDER>>
dard ki taygh se us ghadi ay pidar
haye mera kaleja to kat jayega
aap ke soone hujre mai jab aap ka
mujhko khaali musalla nazar aayega
aap ko dil tadap kar ke dega sada
sabr kaise karungi wahan mai bhala
baba jaan alwida...
baap ka ghar se...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap kehte thay kufa badal jayega
lag raha hai wo din aagaya hai khareeb
ab yaqeen hogaya aap ke shehr mein
ek din hone waali hai zainab ghareeb
hai jahan meri shaahi usi shehr mein
qaid ho kar ke aaungi mai berida
baba jaan alwida...
baap ka ghar se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere baba jaan hum ne socha na tha
chod kar aap hum ko chale jayenge
baap ki wo nigahein mohabbat bhari
aaj ke baad bacche kahan payenge
mera abbas jaa karke dehleez par
kiske aane ka dekhega ab raasta
baba jaan alwida...
baap ka ghar se...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye waiz hua ek mehshar bapa
ay ali jab ye zainab ne rokar kaha
roye hasnain o abbas sar peet kar
baap se jab beti ne ki ilteja
waqt e shaam e ghariban jo doon mai sada
aap aakar badhana mera hausla
baba jaan alwida...
baap ka ghar se...
author: Waiz Sultanpuri
